title: Piaggio MP3 530 Exclusive 3-Wheel
description: The Vespa Piaggio MP3 530 Exclusive 3-Wheel is crafted for effortless city navigation and exceptional fuel economy, positioned in the Commuter Scooter segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 110 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. The cockpit is configured with an Step-Through Upright riding stance and an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
